title: B-tree cached page lookup

scope.rationale: btreePageLookup returns the B-tree page wrapper only when the requested page is already present in the Pager cache, otherwise null, and initializes wrapper ownership through the shared registry.

external_source_responsibilities: Shared pages registry mirrors cached Pager pages and caller owns B-tree synchronization
dependencies.caller_closure: The complete hit/miss lookup is assigned and all internal cached-page consumers route through the helper.

contracts.ownership: Returned page remains owned by Shared; no new reference or allocation is created in the bounded representation.
contracts.state_and_results: First matching page number is returned. Missing number returns null. No fields are mutated.
contracts.locks_callbacks_io: Caller owns B-tree synchronization. No callback or I/O.

representation_differences: The source first calls sqlite3PagerLookup and then btreePageFromDbPage. Zig's shared pages registry already stores initialized Page wrappers for cached pages, so the bounded helper searches that registry directly without incrementing references.

oracle.protocol: Insert cached page 2, look up 2 and compare identity, then look up missing page 99 and observe null.
oracle.normalization: Pager DbPage-to-MemPage adaptation is normalized to the existing Zig Page wrapper identity.

assurance.io_crash_concurrency: No I/O; caller owns B-tree synchronization.
assurance.malformed_input: Arbitrary page number safely returns null when absent.
assurance.performance: Zig bounded registry lookup is linear rather than the source PCache hash lookup; performance integration remains open.

integration.native_call_path: findPage delegates to lookupCachedPage, so cursor, balance, integrity, and mutation owners consume it.

independent_review.notes: Requires Pager reference semantics/performance trace, assurance closure, and independent review.

known_blockers: Integrate or differentially normalize Pager lookup reference semantics and replace linear lookup if needed.
